name: Unknown Distance PDF and MIS
definition: A technique to enable Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) for path-construction strategies (like NEE or bidirectional techniques) in rejection-based trackers where the free-path sample PDF cannot be evaluated exactly. It solves the problem of combining strategies by ensuring the unknown distance PDFs cancel out in the MIS weight calculation.
summary: Unknown Distance PDF and MIS enables Multiple Importance Sampling in rejection-based volumetric trackers by ensuring unknown distance PDFs cancel out, allowing weights to be computed using only directional PDFs.
